args.final_thought: [{"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":13,"var":"data,size","code":"blosc2_schunk_from_buffer((uint8_t *) data, size, false)","note":"Attacker-controlled raw input is passed directly into frame parsing without any preprocessing, so every later field comes from bytes in the PoC."},{"step":2,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_from_buffer","line":null,"var":"frame","code":"The buffer is interpreted as a Blosc2 frame","note":"The fuzzer target treats the input as a serialized frame, making malformed frame metadata attacker-controlled."},{"step":3,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":null,"var":"schunk->chunks[cchunk]","code":"Frame chunk metadata is read and a lazy chunk object is created","note":"Chunk offsets, sizes, and codec-related metadata are propagated from the raw frame into internal chunk state."},{"step":4,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":null,"var":"chunk/lazychunk","code":"A chunk is decompressed using metadata-derived pointers and ownership state","note":"This is the critical propagation step where malformed frame state influences whether the chunk buffer is freed or reused."},{"step":5,"file":"blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk","line":null,"var":"dest","code":"blosc2_decompress_ctx is invoked on the selected chunk","note":"The decompressor consumes the attacker-controlled chunk descriptor and may trigger cleanup paths based on inconsistent metadata."},{"step":6,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":null,"var":"chunk->data","code":"Chunk cleanup releases the chunk buffer on an ownership path that is reached with invalid frame state","note":"A malformed frame can cause the same allocation to be released twice or an already-freed pointer to be freed again, producing the invalid-free crash."}]]
